text:
tess: we need a final decision on where rate limits live across hosting modes. quick, concrete proposals please.

sam: short: hosted -> control-plane preflight + runtime final check; dedicated/private -> runtime source-of-truth. private must support offline signed bundles.

marco: to avoid double charging during fallbacks: router requests an admission_ticket from control-plane (admission_id + allowed_tokens + expires_at) and forwards admission_id to runtime. control-plane dedupes by admission_id on reconciliation.

anya: offline bundles should carry bundle_id, signature, version, offline_budget_seconds and a human changelog. runtime may issue local admissions only if bundle.offline_allowed==true. defaults: bundle TTL=24h, admission TTL=5s, offline_budget=3600s.

tess: client surface must be consistent: always return 429 on rate-limit with header X-Redwood-Quota-Origin and structured body {reason, origin, admission_id, retry_after}. SDKs will map to QuotaError.

sam: security: admission_id must be opaque (HMAC(router_key, nonce||ts)). router keys rotate quarterly; runtime should accept current+previous key for a short grace window. do not embed tenant names.

marco: runtime capability manifest: supports_admission_id, supports_fallback, consumption_precision (estimated|exact). router uses capability flags to choose fallback targets.

anya: reconciliation: runtime POST /usage-report [{admission_id,tokens,ts}]. control-plane verifies local admissions against bundle policy & deducts from offline_budget; dedupe by admission_id.

deploy-bot: canary: admission-proto v0.9 rolled to staging by @sam.

tess: i'll draft an RFC addendum with headers, bundle schema, reconciliation API, telemetry (admission_latency_ms, admission_cache_hit, offline_budget_remaining) and tests: fallback double-count sim, key-rotation, offline reconcile. pinging @sam @marco @anya for review.
